name: Sundered Wheel Cultist

bonuses.name: Labour Augmetics
bonuses.text: Add +4 dice for Tests to lift heavy loads and ignore the penalty for using Heavy weapons.

abilities.name: Cybernetic Abomination
abilities.text: Anyone that can see this Threat must make a DN 2 Fear Test

options.name: Broken Wheel Complications
options.text: Sidebar table printed under the block, d6. 1 Explodes in Breech: Deals base damage to attacker, weapon damaged too badly to use. 2 Dud!: Attack has no effect. 3 Jam: Weapon jams, requiring a DN2 Tech (Int) Test to use again. 4 Ricochet: Attack affects one additional random target. 5 Fouling: Add +1 to the DN of all Tests to use this weapon until it is taken apart and cleaned. 6 Overheating: Weapon becomes too hot to hold for 3 rounds.

note: Improperly Used Tool prints 'Range 1'. The Broken Wheel Complications table is a sidebar, kept as a variant option.
